discovery.summary: Review a Pennsylvania vendor counterparty before automated intake
discovery.description: Resolve a supplied Pennsylvania company name to one unique strong Department of State legal-entity match, screen the resolved legal name against current OFAC SDN primary names and aliases, verify the supplied domain through authoritative RDAP, require legal-name/domain alignment, and compare registration age against a caller threshold. Returns proceed or human_review. Proceed only means the configured review triggers were not hit; it is not legal/compliance approval, sanctions clearance, fraud scoring, credit approval, good-standing certification, or proof of domain ownership/control.
discovery.resource_description: Resolve a Pennsylvania vendor to a unique legal entity, screen that resolved legal name against current OFAC SDN primary names and aliases, and check whether the supplied registered domain plausibly aligns with the legal name and is old enough for automated continuation. Returns proceed or human_review with evidence. Proceed is not legal/compliance approval or sanctions clearance.

buyer.task: Give an autonomous agent a bounded proceed or human_review decision for a prospective Pennsylvania vendor using legal-entity identity, OFAC SDN candidate-name screening, and domain registration/name/age evidence.

expected_purchase_frequency.measurement_plan: Measure independently verified external settled purchases and repeat demand; do not treat synthetic fixtures, public discovery or HTTP 200 as sales.

sources.authority: Pennsylvania Department of State via data.pa.gov
sources.refresh_policy: live lookup on each paid request

sources.authority: U.S. Treasury OFAC SDN names and aliases
sources.refresh_policy: authoritative source lookup on each paid request, subject to adapter caching behavior
sources.cache_policy: source-specific adapter caching; no new cache introduced by spec

sources.authority: IANA DNS bootstrap plus authoritative registry RDAP
sources.refresh_policy: authoritative domain lookup on each paid request
sources.cache_policy: IANA bootstrap cached in memory for adapter lifetime; authoritative domain result not cached

rules: Resolve a unique strong Pennsylvania legal entity before OFAC screening or RDAP legal-name alignment.
Require no current OFAC name candidates at configured score, legal-name-aligned registered RDAP domain, and domain age at or above minDomainAgeDays.
Any uncertain, conflicting, recent-domain, name-candidate, or missing required evidence is human_review, never a legal clearance.
proceed is only a workflow signal that configured review triggers were not hit
a no-candidate OFAC name result is not sanctions clearance
OFAC 50 Percent Rule ownership analysis is not included
domain registration/name alignment does not prove domain ownership or control
recent domain registration is a review signal, not proof of fraud
a Pennsylvania registry match does not prove good standing, ownership, authority to contract, creditworthiness, or legal compliance

failure_behavior.required_source_failure: HTTP 502 with chargeable=false; do not settle payment.

criteria: Existing exact-revision release gate and deterministic tests must pass before a reviewed deployment.
Independently verify authoritative-source availability, payment identity, and current facilitator fee/allowance terms.
Commercial release remains blocked until true hosting/source/refund economics and independently verified customer demand are established.
